abstract: This paper examines how global greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI) flows are evolving amid rising geoeconomic fragmentation. We use difference-in-differences and event study approaches to analyze changes in FDI around key bilateral inflection points. We find a decline in FDI from the US and broader Group of Seven Plus (G7+) into the PRC, concentrated in trade-exposed, efficiency-seeking sectors. Investment diversion—particularly from the PRC to Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) members and Latin America—is evident, but this growth was concentrated in less global value chain (GVC)-integrated activities, suggesting that GVC links may act as a constraint on investment relocation. These findings suggest that while tensions may be reshaping global investment, GVC dependencies are likely limiting firms’ ability to reallocate production at scale, making the “great reallocation” least evident where it was most expected.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在地缘经济碎片化加剧的背景下，全球绿地外商直接投资（FDI）流动的演变趋势。我们采用双重差分法和事件研究法，分析关键双边关系转折点前后FDI的变化。研究发现，来自美国及更广泛的七国集团+（G7+）经济体对中国的FDI有所下降，且主要集中在贸易敏感型、效率寻求型行业。投资转移现象明显——尤其是从中国流向东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）成员国和拉丁美洲——但这种增长集中于全球价值链（GVC）整合程度较低的活动，表明GVC联系可能对投资重新布局构成制约。这些发现表明，尽管地缘紧张局势可能正在重塑全球投资格局，但GVC依赖关系很可能限制了企业大规模重新配置生产能力，使得“大转移”在最被预期的领域反而最不明显。

abstract: This study investigates the practice of re-audits—where an incoming audit firm re-audits the prior year’s financial statements previously examined by a predecessor audit firm. We examine the costs and benefits of such re-audits. We find that re-audits are more likely when the risks of misstatement are high and when incoming auditors can expect to win more clients by identifying material misstatements overlooked by predecessor auditors. Our results show that incoming auditors who perform re-audits are more successful in winning new clients from predecessor auditors. Moreover, re-audits result in significantly more restatements. However, consistent with the resource-intensive nature of re-audits, we also find that they are associated with longer audit delays and higher audit fees. Overall, we conclude that re-audits have important consequences for financial statement users, incoming auditors, and predecessor auditors.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了重新审计的实践——即新接任的审计事务所对前任审计事务所先前审查过的上一年度财务报表进行再次审计。我们考察了此类重新审计的成本与效益。研究发现，当错报风险较高，且新接任审计师预期通过识别前任审计师遗漏的重大错报而赢得更多客户时，重新审计更可能发生。结果显示，执行重新审计的新接任审计师在从前任审计师处争取新客户方面更为成功。此外，重新审计显著增加了重述的发生。然而，与重新审计的资源密集型特性相一致，我们也发现其与更长的审计延迟和更高的审计费用相关联。总体而言，我们得出结论，重新审计对财务报表使用者、新接任审计师及前任审计师均具有重要影响。
title: Re-doing the audit
title_zh: 重新进行审计

abstract: This paper examines the association between managers' failure to incorporate macroeconomic news and firm performance, focusing on the role of competitors. Measuring this failure using the extent to which management revenue forecast errors reflect U.S. consumer sentiment, we find an asymmetric association. When firms underestimate consumer demand and underproduce, failing to incorporate consumer sentiment news is associated with worse performance, but when they overestimate demand and overproduce, no association exists. These results are consistent with competitors reacting differently to underproduction and overproduction, worsening firm performance in the case of underproduction but not necessarily in overproduction. Cross-sectional analyses reveal that the negative association is mainly present when U.S. consumer sentiment is important and strategic interactions are stronger, such as in markets with higher product similarity. Overall, our findings suggest that the performance consequences of forecast errors due to failure to understand macroeconomic information are nuanced and depend on competitors’ strategic actions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了管理者未能纳入宏观经济新闻与企业绩效之间的关联，重点关注竞争对手的作用。通过以管理层收入预测误差反映美国消费者情绪的程度来衡量这一失败，我们发现了一种不对称的关联。当企业低估消费者需求并减少生产时，未能纳入消费者情绪新闻与较差的绩效相关；但当企业高估需求并过度生产时，则不存在这种关联。这些结果与竞争对手对生产不足和生产过剩的不同反应一致，即在生产不足情况下会恶化企业绩效，而在生产过剩情况下则未必如此。横截面分析显示，这种负面关联主要出现在美国消费者情绪重要且战略互动更强的市场中，例如产品相似度较高的市场。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，因未能理解宏观经济信息而导致的预测误差对绩效的影响是微妙的，并取决于竞争对手的战略行动。
title: Managers’ understanding of macroeconomic news, competitor influence, and firm performance: Evidence from consumer sentiment news
title_zh: 管理者对宏观经济新闻的理解、竞争对手影响与企业绩效：来自消费者情绪新闻的证据

abstract: How do armed groups reshape cities? This article argues that Rio de Janeiro’s milícias—paramilitary organizations, frequently led by current and former security officers,—govern territory through “build-to-hold” urbanization. Rather than simply extracting rents, milícias construct informal housing to expand captive populations that generate recurring income, electoral leverage, and political protection. Combining geospatial data on territorial control with satellite-derived measures of urban development from 2016–2023, I use staggered difference-in-differences estimators to show that milícia entry causes sustained increases in building density and height. These effects are absent in gang-controlled areas and persist in territories transitioning from gangs to milícias, indicating that densification is specific to the milícia governance model. I further show that increased construction does not increase formal housing prices or transaction activity, consistent with a system in which armed actors retain control over housing assets rather than integrating them into formal markets. The findings demonstrate how criminal organizations actively produce urban space in ways that entrench coercive authority and blur the boundary between criminal governance and state power.
abstract_zh: 武装团体如何重塑城市？本文认为，里约热内卢的民兵组织——通常由现任或前任安全官员领导的准军事组织——通过“建设-持有”城市化模式统治领土。民兵组织并非单纯攫取租金，而是建造非正规住房以扩大受控人口规模，从而获取持续性收入、选举筹码和政治庇护。通过将领土控制的地理空间数据与2016-2023年卫星衍生的城市发展指标相结合，我采用交错双重差分估计量证明：民兵组织进入会导致建筑密度和高度持续增长。这种效应在帮派控制区域不存在，而在从帮派过渡到民兵组织的领土中持续存在，表明密度增长是民兵治理模式的特有现象。我进一步证明，建筑增加并未推高正规住房价格或交易活跃度，这与武装行为体保留住房资产控制权而非将其纳入正规市场的体系特征一致。研究结果揭示了犯罪组织如何通过主动生产城市空间来巩固强制权力，并模糊犯罪治理与国家权力之间的边界。

abstract: The UK grazing livestock sector is challenged by declining farm profitability and stringent environmental policy. Innovative technologies such as virtual fencing could enable a balanced economic and environmental performance of beef production. Virtual fencing is a livestock management tool relying on invisible boundaries perceived as auditory, electrical, or vibrational cues emitted by devices worn by grazing animals. This analysis compares virtual and conventional fencing from an economic and environmental perspective using a multi‐objective linear programming model. Optimal livestock management scenarios are identified for two typical UK cattle grazing systems. In intensive lowland beef finishing, virtual fencing achieves the lowest economic performance and a beef carbon emission intensity comparable to electric fencing. In an extensive upland suckler cow system, virtual fencing enables ecological conservation and reduces beef carbon emission intensity but increases labour input compared to set stocking. This ex‐ante assessment illustrates how precision grazing technologies can be simultaneously evaluated against economic and environmental objectives. The results indicate that, under current cost structures, virtual fencing is unlikely to be competitive with electric fencing in intensive lowland beef finishing systems, where it delivers similar environmental outcomes at higher cost. In contrast, in upland suckler cow systems, virtual fencing can support habitat protection and reduce beef carbon emission intensity but remains constrained by capital and labour costs. These findings suggest that virtual fencing is unlikely to be widely adopted on purely commercial grounds but could play a targeted role in the delivery of publicly subsidised conservation programmes such as the UK's Environmental Land Management schemes.
abstract_zh: 英国放牧畜牧业面临农场盈利能力下降和严格环境政策的双重挑战。虚拟围栏等创新技术有望实现牛肉生产的经济与环境绩效平衡。虚拟围栏是一种牲畜管理工具，依赖放牧动物佩戴设备发出的听觉、电击或振动信号所感知的隐形边界。本研究采用多目标线性规划模型，从经济与环境视角对比分析虚拟围栏与传统围栏。针对两种典型的英国牛群放牧系统，识别出最优的牲畜管理方案。在集约化低地肉牛育肥系统中，虚拟围栏的经济绩效最低，牛肉碳排放强度与电围栏相当。在粗放型高地哺乳母牛系统中，虚拟围栏虽能促进生态保护并降低牛肉碳排放强度，但相较于固定放牧增加了劳动力投入。这项事前评估展示了如何同时从经济与环境目标维度评价精准放牧技术。结果表明，在当前成本结构下，虚拟围栏在集约化低地肉牛育肥系统中难以与电围栏竞争——其以更高成本实现相似环境效益。相反，在高地哺乳母牛系统中，虚拟围栏可支持栖息地保护并降低牛肉碳排放强度，但仍受资本与劳动力成本制约。这些发现表明，虚拟围栏难以纯粹基于商业理由被广泛采用，但可在英国环境土地管理计划等公共补贴保护项目中发挥针对性作用。
title: An Economic and Environmental Analysis of Virtual Fencing for Precision Grazing

abstract: We investigate monetary policy transmission and energy saving incentives in response to rising energy prices. We add energy in consumption and production, and energy conservation capital, to a tractable New Keynesian model with heterogeneous agents, unemployment risk, and nominal asset holdings. We find that monetary policy influences the energy conservation through both unemployment risk and asset returns; energy price shocks intensify monetary policy trade‐offs in terms of stabilizing inflation and output. A weaker policy response is beneficial in terms of agents' welfare despite higher inflation. The Ramsey policy predicts a strong rise in the policy rate with a decline afterward.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了能源价格上涨背景下货币政策的传导机制与节能激励。我们将能源纳入消费与生产环节，并引入节能资本，构建了一个包含异质性主体、失业风险与名义资产持有的可处理新凯恩斯模型。研究发现：货币政策通过失业风险与资产回报双重渠道影响节能行为；能源价格冲击加剧了货币政策在稳定通胀与产出之间的权衡。尽管通胀水平上升，但较弱的政策响应更有利于提升主体福利。拉姆齐政策预测政策利率将先大幅上升后回落。

abstract: We propose a new approach to production function estimation that integrates the strengths of the proxy‐variable (PV) and dynamic panel data (DPD) methods. Our framework augments the set of instruments for the level equation in Blundell and Bond [8] with a Berkson‐type instrument motivated by economic theory, following Olley and Pakes [28], Levinsohn and Petrin [24], and Ackerberg et al. [4]. This modification allows unobserved productivity to include both a time‐invariant (“fixed‐effect”) component and a time‐varying component that follows a potentially nonlinear Markov process. Whereas the PV approach accommodates nonlinear Markov dynamics but not fixed effects, and the DPD approach accounts for fixed effects but only with linear Markov dynamics, our method relaxes both restrictions. Our estimator is straightforward to implement using GMM. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that it outperforms the canonical PV and DPD estimators when productivity persistence is low and fixed‐effect heterogeneity is substantial.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种新的生产函数估计方法，融合了代理变量法与动态面板数据法的优势。我们的框架在Blundell和Bond [8]的水平方程工具变量集中，引入了一个基于经济理论的Berkson型工具变量，遵循Olley和Pakes [28]、Levinsohn和Petrin [24]以及Ackerberg等人[4]的思路。这一改进允许不可观测的生产率同时包含时不变（“固定效应”）成分和遵循潜在非线性马尔可夫过程的时变成分。代理变量法虽能处理非线性马尔可夫动态但无法应对固定效应，动态面板数据法则能处理固定效应但仅适用于线性马尔可夫动态，而我们的方法同时放宽了这两项限制。该估计量可通过广义矩估计法简便实现。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，当生产率持续性较低且固定效应异质性显著时，本方法优于经典代理变量法和动态面板数据法估计量。
title: A Unified Approach to Estimating Production Functions: Proxy Variables and Dynamic Panel Data
title_zh: 生产函数估计的统一方法：代理变量与动态面板数据

abstract: To evaluate the role played by startup companies in the innovation ecosystem of US agriculture, we compile a unique dataset of 6024 new entrants founded 1987–2019 that details their financing lifecycles, annual economic performance, and patenting activities. One‐third of the firms in the sample have observable signs of contributing to innovation, including patenting and external financing such as grants and venture capital, thus characterizing them as startups. Such startups and their financing have grown substantially over the period studied. We use discrete‐time survival analysis to test factors related to firms receiving venture financing as well as to firms achieving successful financial exits. We find those firms that file for patents have higher likelihood of receiving financing than those that do not. Patent filings also increase the relative probability of a successful financial exit, which takes place primarily through mergers and acquisitions. In about a third of such exits, startups are acquired by corporate incumbents in agriculture well positioned to scale up and commercialize those startups' innovations for US agriculture. Importantly, a substantial portion of firms in the sample are still too young to have attained venture financing let alone a financial exit.
abstract_zh: 为评估初创企业在美国农业创新生态系统中的作用，我们构建了一个包含1987-2019年间成立的6024家新企业的独特数据集，详细记录了其融资生命周期、年度经济绩效及专利活动。样本中三分之一的公司展现出可观测的创新贡献迹象，包括专利申请及获得赠款、风险投资等外部融资，从而被界定为初创企业。此类初创企业及其融资规模在研究期间显著增长。我们采用离散时间生存分析法，检验影响企业获得风险融资及实现成功财务退出的因素。研究发现，提交专利申请的企业获得融资的可能性高于未申请企业。专利申请同时提高了企业成功实现财务退出的相对概率，此类退出主要通过并购完成。在约三分之一的退出案例中，初创企业被农业领域具备规模化推广及商业化能力的现有企业收购，从而将其创新成果应用于美国农业。值得注意的是，样本中相当比例的企业仍处于发展初期，尚未获得风险融资，更遑论实现财务退出。
title: The role of venture‐financed startups in innovation for US agriculture

abstract: We develop a rational, Walrasian model of speculative bubbles inspired by the Kindleberger–Minsky view, which describes bubbles as wave‐like market processes. Touched off by an initial shock, price booms are initially self‐reinforcing but become self‐destructive later when prices surpass fundamental value. Previous models in this vein have been criticized due to ad hoc features, such as prices driven by behavioral forces or particular trading protocols. Our model allays these concerns by relying only on multidimensional uncertainty to prevent unraveling via backward induction. Standard market clearing, moreover, makes the model more compatible with established macroeconomic and asset pricing frameworks.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个受金德尔伯格-明斯基观点启发的理性瓦尔拉斯投机泡沫模型，该模型将泡沫描述为波浪式的市场过程。在初始冲击触发下，价格繁荣初期呈现自我强化特征，但当价格超越基本面价值后则转向自我毁灭。此前同类模型因依赖行为因素驱动价格或特定交易规则等特设性设定而受到批评。我们的模型仅通过多维不确定性来防止逆向归纳导致的泡沫瓦解，从而缓解了这些担忧。此外，标准市场出清机制使该模型与既有的宏观经济和资产定价框架更具兼容性。
title: Rational Expectations Fools' Bubbles

abstract: 随着我国人口老龄化程度不断深化,老年群体的家庭财务状况受到广泛关注。本文构建了一个生命周期模型,分析退休对家庭消费和资产配置的影响,为理解退休与家庭财务脆弱性之间的因果关系提供了一个结构化的分析视角。在此基础上,模糊断点回归分析表明,退休会显著增加家庭的财务脆弱性,不同形式的稳健性检验均支持这一结论。进一步分析发现,退休使家庭收入大于预期支出的概率显著上升,使家庭流动性资产小于非预期支出的概率显著上升。异质性分析显示,退休对低人力资本、低社会资本、低物质资本和高健康风险家庭的财务脆弱性影响更大。本文为全面认识家庭财务脆弱性提供了新的视角,为老龄化背景下相关政策的制定提供了参考依据。

abstract: This paper exploits China’s Environmental Protection Tax Reform (CEPTR) as a quasi-natural experiment to examine whether market-based environmental regulation can simultaneously enhance productivity and reduce pollution. Using panel data on A-share listed firms over the period 2012–2024 and a difference-in-differences (DID) framework, we evaluate the reform’s impact on firms’ total factor productivity (TFP) and pollutant emissions. The results reveal a clear ‘double dividend’ effect: CEPTR significantly increases TFP while simultaneously reducing emissions. Mechanism analyses indicate that these effects are primarily driven by three channels: the promotion of green innovation, increased R&D investment and the alleviation of financing constraints. Heterogeneity analysis shows that firms in moderately polluting industries experience the most pronounced improvements in both productivity and emission reduction, suggesting that the reform is particularly effective where regulatory pressure is neither too weak nor excessively stringent. Overall, the findings provide firm-level evidence supporting the Porter Hypothesis in the context of a major developing economy and highlight the role of environmental taxation as an effective policy instrument for achieving coordinated economic and environmental gains.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国环境保护税改革（CEPTR）作为准自然实验，考察基于市场的环境规制能否同时提升生产率并减少污染。基于2012—2024年A股上市公司面板数据及双重差分（DID）框架，我们评估了该改革对企业全要素生产率（TFP）和污染物排放的影响。研究结果揭示了明显的“双重红利”效应：CEPTR显著提高了TFP，同时减少了排放。机制分析表明，这些效应主要通过三条渠道实现：促进绿色创新、增加研发投入以及缓解融资约束。异质性分析显示，中度污染行业的企业在生产率提升和减排方面均表现出最显著的改善，这表明改革在监管压力既不过弱也不过强的情境下尤为有效。总体而言，本文的研究发现为波特假说在大型发展中经济体的适用性提供了企业层面的证据，并凸显了环境税作为实现经济与环境协同增效的有效政策工具的作用。

abstract: This article investigates how firm-level financial positions shape corporate investment responses to policy-related monetary shocks in China. Guided by a heterogeneous firm framework in which net worth governs financing constraints, we link an event-based monetary shock measure to panel data on Chinese listed firms. We document three main findings. First, monetary transmission varies systematically with within-firm leverage states: following expansionary shocks, firms with leverage above their own historical average experience larger reductions in effective financing costs and stronger increases in investment. This pattern is consistent with an important role for the balance-sheet channel in a bank-dominated financial system. Second, this heterogeneity is asymmetric: it is pronounced during monetary easing but statistically insignificant during tightening episodes. Third, ownership structure matters. The leverage-driven amplification is substantial among non-state-owned firms but muted among state-owned enterprises. Overall, our findings show that balance-sheet conditions and institutional frictions jointly shape the investment transmission of monetary policy in China, with implications for the design of stabilization policy and structural reform.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业层面的财务状况如何塑造中国企业对政策性货币冲击的投资反应。在净财富决定融资约束的异质性企业框架指导下，我们将基于事件的货币冲击度量与我国上市公司面板数据相结合。我们记录了三个主要发现。首先，货币传导随企业内杠杆状态的系统性变化：在扩张性冲击之后，杠杆高于自身历史平均水平的企业，其有效融资成本降幅更大，投资增长更为强劲。这一模式与银行主导金融体系中资产负债表渠道的重要作用相一致。其次，这种异质性具有不对称性：在货币宽松时期显著，而在紧缩阶段统计上不显著。第三，所有权结构具有影响。杠杆驱动的放大效应在非国有企业中显著，而在国有企业中则较为微弱。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，资产负债表状况和制度性摩擦共同塑造了中国货币政策对投资传导的影响，这对稳定政策的设计和结构性改革具有启示意义。

abstract: Marketing channel choice plays a crucial role in shaping small-scale grain farmers’ production decisions and sales outcomes, yet empirical evidence remains limited. This study categorizes grain farmers’ marketing channel choices into farmgate (door-to-door), non-farmgate informal, and non-farmgate formal channels. We examine the effects of marketing channel choice on fertilizer expenditure, pesticide expenditure, production costs, and sales frequency. Using a multivalued treatment effects (MVTE) framework with the inverse probability weighted regression adjustment (IPWRA) estimator, we address selection bias and estimate open-access data from the 2020 China Rural Revitalization Survey. Results show that, compared with selling through the farmgate channel, selling through the non-farmgate informal channel is associated with higher sales frequency. Compared with both farmgate and non-farmgate informal channels, selling through the non-farmgate formal channel is associated with lower fertilizer and pesticide expenditures, production costs, and sale frequency. Heterogeneity analysis further shows that these associations are more pronounced among small farms and vary with distance to town. This study offers practical implications for designing market-oriented interventions to strengthen smallholder farmers’ access to formal, organized marketing channels.
abstract_zh: 营销渠道选择在塑造小规模粮农的生产决策与销售成果中扮演关键角色，然而相关实证证据仍显不足。本研究将粮农的营销渠道选择划分为田间地头（上门收购）、非田间地头非正式渠道及非田间地头正式渠道三类。我们考察了营销渠道选择对化肥支出、农药支出、生产成本及销售频率的影响。采用多值处理效应（MVTE）框架，结合逆概率加权回归调整（IPWRA）估计量，我们处理了选择偏差，并基于2020年中国乡村振兴调查的公开数据进行了估算。结果显示，与通过田间地头渠道销售相比，通过非田间地头非正式渠道销售与更高的销售频率相关联。与田间地头及非田间地头非正式渠道相比，通过非田间地头正式渠道销售则与较低的化肥和农药支出、生产成本及销售频率相关联。异质性分析进一步表明，这些关联在小规模农场中更为显著，并随距城镇距离的变化而有所不同。本研究为设计以市场为导向的干预措施，以增强小农户获取正式、有组织营销渠道的能力提供了实践启示。

abstract: We study whether restaurants in more visible urban locations receive different customer ratings, consistent with consumer-search models in which prominence interacts with search frictions. Using 1.5 million Yelp reviews of 61,000 restaurants in 18 cities across eight countries, we relate ratings to three location-based proxies for prominence: proximity to tourist landmarks, street corners, and public squares. Across specifications with rich controls and user-city fixed effects, restaurants in more prominent locations receive lower ratings. The results are robust to comparing nearby establishments and to checks addressing selection, crowding, and measurement, and we interpret them as consistent with a worse price–quality mix in prominent locations when continued search is costly.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了位于更显眼城市地段的餐厅是否获得不同的顾客评分，这与消费者搜索模型中显眼性与搜索摩擦相互作用的理论相符。基于八个国家18个城市中61,000家餐厅的150万条Yelp评论，我们将评分与三个基于位置的显眼性代理指标相关联：靠近旅游地标、街角和公共广场。在包含丰富控制变量和用户-城市固定效应的多种规格中，位于更显眼位置的餐厅评分较低。这些结果在比较邻近场所及处理选择、拥挤和测量问题的检验中依然稳健，我们将其解释为与显眼位置在持续搜索成本高昂时提供较差价格-质量组合的现象一致。

abstract: We use regulatory data on the foreign claims and liabilities of global banks with U.S. operations to study how multinational lenders respond to large natural disasters abroad. Our difference-in-difference estimates show that, on average, international banks do not increase their lending to countries after destructive disasters that should increase the demand for funds. Consistent with information frictions, our results show that post-disaster lending is higher among banks with foreign affiliate offices and stronger pre-disaster lending relationships in affected countries. Our estimates predict substantial heterogeneity across countries in post-disaster international lending, with poorer countries seeing substantial declines and increases among richer countries.
abstract_zh: 我们利用全球银行在美国运营的外国债权与负债监管数据，研究跨国银行如何应对海外重大自然灾害。我们的双重差分估计显示，平均而言，在破坏性灾害发生后，国际银行并未增加对受灾国的贷款，尽管这些灾害理应提升资金需求。与信息摩擦一致，我们的结果表明，在受灾国设有外国分支机构且灾前贷款关系较强的银行，其灾后贷款水平更高。我们的估计预测，各国在灾后国际贷款方面存在显著异质性，较贫穷国家贷款大幅下降，而较富裕国家则有所增加。
title: Global banks and natural disasters
title_zh: 全球银行与自然灾害

abstract: This paper analyzes a decentralized matching environment in which agents privately observe their ability but must choose between two mutually exclusive sectors before learning their relative rank. The sectors differ in their payoff distributions, and positions within each are assigned via positive assortative matching. Thus, outcomes depend both on ability and on the endogenous congestion created by agents’ sectoral choices. I characterize the unique symmetric Bayesian Nash equilibrium, which exhibits a cutoff structure: high-ability agents select the high-payoff sector with certainty, while low-ability agents mix to trade off match quality against the risk of being crowded out. The equilibrium choice probability is continuous within groups but displays a discontinuous jump at the sorting threshold. A key welfare finding is that rank uncertainty can raise the expected utility of some low-ability agents relative to a complete information benchmark. The analysis shows how private information induces endogenous discontinuities in strategies and heterogeneous welfare effects across types.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了一个分散匹配环境，其中代理人私下观察自身能力，但在了解相对排名之前，必须在两个互斥部门之间做出选择。这两个部门的收益分配不同，且每个部门内的职位通过正向分类匹配进行分配。因此，结果既取决于能力，也取决于代理人部门选择所产生的内生拥挤效应。我刻画了唯一对称贝叶斯纳什均衡，该均衡呈现截断结构：高能力代理人确定性地选择高收益部门，而低能力代理人则进行混合策略，以在匹配质量与被挤出风险之间权衡。均衡选择概率在群体内是连续的，但在分类阈值处表现出不连续的跳跃。一个关键的福利发现是，排名不确定性可以提高某些低能力代理人相对于完全信息基准的预期效用。分析表明，私人信息如何引发策略中的内生不连续性以及不同类型间异质的福利效应。
title: Sorting and matching under rank uncertainty
title_zh: 排名不确定下的分类与匹配

abstract: I study the stationary wealth distribution in a dynamic model of financial markets in which investors differ in their levels of investment sophistication. Some investors form beliefs rationally but have access to different information, while others hold incorrect beliefs. For all investor types, the stationary wealth distribution exhibits a thick upper tail, whose thickness depends on the higher moments of portfolio returns relative to the aggregate market. The upper tail of the overall stationary wealth distribution is populated by the group with the thickest tail. I show that this group is either a rational group with an undominated information set or the group with incorrect beliefs, despite the latter earning the lowest expected return. To explain the observed degrees of wealth concentration, it is sufficient that some investor groups earn an expected excess return of 0.89% per annum relative to the aggregate economy – consistent with the risk-adjusted returns generated by hedge funds and private equity funds and their portfolio shares among the ultra-wealthy in the United States. A calibration of the model matches the distribution of average returns for Norwegian households documented by Fagereng et al. (2020).
abstract_zh: 我研究了一个动态金融市场模型中的稳态财富分布，其中投资者的投资 sophistication 水平各异。部分投资者理性形成信念但获取的信息不同，而其他投资者则持有错误信念。对于所有投资者类型，稳态财富分布均呈现厚尾特征，其厚度取决于投资组合收益相对于整体市场的更高阶矩。整体稳态财富分布的上尾部分由尾部最厚的群体占据。我证明，这一群体要么是拥有无支配信息集的理性群体，要么是持有错误信念的群体，尽管后者获得的预期收益最低。为解释观察到的财富集中程度，只需某些投资者群体相对于整体经济每年获得0.89%的预期超额收益即可——这与对冲基金和私募股权基金产生的风险调整后收益及其在美国超级富豪中的投资组合份额相符。模型校准结果与Fagereng等人（2020）记录的挪威家庭平均收益分布相匹配。
title: Investment Sophistication and Wealth Inequality
title_zh: 投资成熟度与财富不平等

abstract: We study dynamic coordination with costly switching, where players are initially uncertain regarding how to coordinate. We model two players searching for compatible platforms in the presence of two kinds of frictions: noisy outcomes and costly switching. The model predicts that players remain on their current platforms whenever their common belief is sufficiently optimistic; otherwise, they randomize their actions, switching with higher probability whenever they are more pessimistic about compatibility, switching is less costly, or success conditional on compatibility is more likely. In an experiment, we vary (i) whether success is Deterministic or Stochastic when players are on compatible platforms and (ii) the cost of switching. We allow subjects to choose explicit mixed strategies to provide a better test of the theory. The data are consistent with most comparative statics predictions, particularly in the Deterministic case, but differ from some of the other theoretical predictions. To explain the disparities between theory and the data, particularly when learning is noisy and switching is costly, we discuss the impacts of several factors, including cognitive ability, inattention, sensitivity to recent failures, and experience.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在存在昂贵转换成本的动态协调问题，其中参与者最初对于如何协调存在不确定性。我们构建了一个模型，涉及两名参与者在两种摩擦条件下寻找兼容平台：结果的不确定性和转换成本的高昂。模型预测，当参与者的共同信念足够乐观时，他们会留在当前平台；否则，他们会随机化行动，且在以下情况下更可能以更高概率转换：对兼容性的悲观程度增加、转换成本降低，或兼容条件下成功的可能性增大。在实验中，我们操纵了两个变量：（i）当参与者处于兼容平台时，成功结果是确定性的还是随机性的；（ii）转换成本的高低。我们允许受试者选择明确的混合策略，以更严格地检验理论。数据与大多数比较静态预测相符，尤其是在确定性情形下，但与其他一些理论预测存在差异。为解释理论与数据之间的偏差，特别是在学习过程伴随噪声且转换成本高昂的情况下，我们探讨了包括认知能力、注意力不集中、对近期失败的敏感度以及经验在内的多种因素的影响。
title: Dynamic coordination with switching costs
title_zh: 具有转换成本的动态协调

abstract: Bulte et al. (2018), examining the effects of the 2008 earthquake in China, report quasi-experimental evidence of Dutch Disease dynamics in the context of post-disaster aid and recovery. The authors’ conclusion from the synthetic control analysis relies exclusively on visual inspection of the post-earthquake gap between the treated unit and its synthetic control, without implementing the method’s formal inferential procedures. Our reanalysis shows that, while the gap may appear visually large and persistent over time, it is not statistically significant. Within the synthetic control framework, we find no evidence supporting aid-induced Dutch Disease dynamics. This weakens the original study’s conclusion by showing that the reported effect is not robust to alternative methods.
abstract_zh: Bulte等人（2018）在考察2008年中国地震影响时，报告了灾后援助与恢复背景下荷兰病动态的准实验证据。作者基于合成控制分析得出的结论，仅依赖于对处理单元与其合成控制之间地震后差距的视觉检查，而未实施该方法的正式推断程序。我们的再分析表明，尽管这一差距在视觉上可能显得较大且随时间持续存在，但在统计上并不显著。在合成控制框架内，我们未发现支持援助引发的荷兰病动态的证据。这通过表明所报告效应在替代方法下不具稳健性，削弱了原研究的结论。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Post-disaster aid and development of the manufacturing sector: Lessons from a natural experiment in China revisited
title_zh: 灾后援助与制造业发展：基于中国自然实验的再审视

abstract: I develop a novel upwind scheme to solve the Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman (HJB) equation with two endogenous state variables. The algorithm chooses the upwind direction that gives the largest Hamiltonian to numerically determine optimal policies over the full state space. The choice of upwind direction in each iteration is intuitive, and can be implemented without splitting asset drifts into multiple components. I compare optimal policy functions on a wealth grid produced by the upwind scheme with those obtained from the splitting scheme used in the literature, and find discrepancies of policy functions at the boundaries.
abstract_zh: 我开发了一种新颖的上风格式，用于求解具有两个内生状态变量的Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman（HJB）方程。该算法选择产生最大Hamiltonian的上风方向，以数值方式确定整个状态空间上的最优策略。每次迭代中上风方向的选择直观易懂，且无需将资产漂移分解为多个分量即可实现。我将上风格式在财富网格上生成的最优策略函数与文献中使用的分裂格式所得结果进行了比较，发现策略函数在边界处存在差异。
title: An upwind scheme for continuous-time optimization with two endogenous state variables
title_zh: 两个内生状态变量连续时间优化的迎风格式

abstract: This paper reveals that the regression-based trend-cycle decomposition of Hamilton (2018) introduces spurious cyclical dynamics when time series undergo structural breaks. Because the filter relies on an h -step ahead projection, trend adjustment mechanically lags behind regime shifts, inducing large and persistent biases in the cyclical component. We propose a parsimonious modification using a dummy-variable structure that allows the regression intercept and autoregressive components to adjust to identified breaks. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations show that this approach substantially reduces Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) across a wide range of data-generating processes. These gains are robust to variations in break magnitude, timing and number; sample size; and signal-to-noise ratio. Notably, our approach remains superior in pseudo-real-time settings, where the benefits from break-adjustment outweigh the costs of recursive break date estimation and revision. An empirical application to the Swiss franc/euro exchange rate demonstrates that our modification avoids the spurious cyclical spikes generated by standard filters during major policy shifts. Both ex-post and recursive real-time estimates confirm that our proposed framework provides a more reliable decomposition for macroeconomic assessment and inference.
abstract_zh: 本文揭示，当时间序列经历结构性突变时，基于回归的Hamilton（2018）趋势-周期分解会引入虚假的周期动态。由于该滤波器依赖于h步超前预测，趋势调整在机制转换后机械地滞后，导致周期成分出现大而持久的偏差。我们提出了一种简约的修正方法，利用虚拟变量结构，使回归截距和自回归成分能够适应已识别的突变。广泛的蒙特卡洛模拟表明，该方法在多种数据生成过程中显著降低了均方根误差（RMSE）。这些改进对突变幅度、时机和数量的变化，以及样本大小和信噪比均具有稳健性。值得注意的是，在伪实时环境中，我们的方法依然表现优越，因为突变调整带来的收益超过了递归突变日期估计和修正的成本。对瑞士法郎/欧元汇率的实证应用表明，我们的修正避免了标准滤波器在重大政策转变期间产生的虚假周期峰值。事后和递归实时估计均证实，我们提出的框架为宏观经济评估和推断提供了更可靠的分解。
title: Accounting for structural breaks in the Hamilton filter
title_zh: 汉密尔顿滤波中结构断点的处理

abstract: In regions with low soil fertility, smallholder farmers often clear forest to sustain agricultural yields. This pattern becomes more problematic where forest regrowth is slow, contributing to local forest loss and global environmental challenges such as climate change and biodiversity decline. This paper presents findings from a framed field experiment that examines how different types of monetary incentives affect forest-clearing decisions in northern Namibia, a semi-arid region with negligible forest regrowth. We implemented a common-pool resource game with 518 smallholder farmers across 25 villages, in which a forest stock declines dynamically based on participants’ clearing decisions, without immediate regrowth. The game spans three periods: a baseline without incentives, an intervention period where participants receive either individual rewards, collective rewards, an individual fee, or no incentives (control group), and a post-incentive phase. This setup allows us to assess both the immediate effects of incentives and their persistence after incentive removal. All incentive types reduce clearing compared to the baseline, but not significantly more than in the control condition, where clearing also declined – an unexpected trend likely linked to features of the dynamic game design. Incentive effects largely dissipate after removal, with no strong evidence of lasting motivational crowding-in or crowding-out. Overall, our results suggest that moderate payments may be insufficient to sustain cooperation in persistent resource dilemmas. More broadly, they highlight the importance of multifaceted analysis including control conditions and careful experimental framing in field-laboratory studies, coupled with caution in generalizing findings to other settings or policy applications.
abstract_zh: 在土壤肥力较低的地区，小农户常通过砍伐森林来维持农业产量。当森林再生缓慢时，这种模式会加剧问题，导致局部森林损失及气候变化、生物多样性下降等全球性环境挑战。本文基于一项框架田野实验，探讨不同货币激励类型如何影响纳米比亚北部（一个森林再生几乎为零的半干旱地区）的森林砍伐决策。我们针对25个村庄的518名小农户开展了一项公共池资源博弈实验：森林存量根据参与者的砍伐决策动态下降，且无即时再生。实验分为三个阶段：无激励基线期、干预期（参与者分别获得个人奖励、集体奖励、个人费用或零激励（对照组））以及激励后阶段。该设计使我们能够评估激励的即时效应及其在激励取消后的持续性。所有激励类型均比基线期减少了砍伐行为，但并未显著优于对照组——对照组砍伐量同样下降，这一意外趋势可能与动态博弈设计特征相关。激励效应在取消后基本消失，未发现持久的动机挤入或挤出效应。总体而言，我们的结果表明，适度支付可能不足以在持续性资源困境中维持合作。更广泛地看，本研究凸显了在田野实验室研究中纳入控制条件、谨慎设计实验框架并进行多维度分析的重要性，同时需警惕将结论推广至其他情境或政策应用。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Introducing and Terminating Monetary Incentives in Non-Regenerating Forests: Insights from a Framed Field Experiment
title_zh: 非再生森林中货币激励的引入与终止：来自框架田野实验的启示

abstract: Which industries lobby the most? I study whether an industry’s position in the production network is associated with reported federal lobbying. The argument is that supplying many downstream customers creates two forces. A policy that helps a supplier can raise privately appropriable stakes when downstream benefits are partly capitalized back to the supplier through derived demand, supplier surplus, contracts, or preservation of customer relationships. The same downstream reach also expands the set of beneficiaries that can free-ride. The model therefore predicts a hump-shaped relationship between downstream reach and focal-industry lobbying. Using a panel of 71 U.S. industries from 1999 to 2023, I find a nonmonotone pattern in mapped LDA lobbying expenditures. The pattern appears in every annual cross-section and is stronger on spending among active industries than on lobbying entry. The estimates are descriptive and apply first to mapped spending. Only about one-third of reported spending maps cleanly to industries, and partial-identification bounds show that inference becomes weaker once the unmapped remainder is taken into account.
abstract_zh: 哪些行业游说支出最高？本文研究行业在生产网络中的位置是否与其联邦游说报告存在关联。核心论点在于：为众多下游客户供货会形成两种作用力。当下游收益通过派生需求、供应商盈余、合同关系或客户关系维护等渠道部分资本化回流至供应商时，有利于供应商的政策可能提升其可私人占有的利益规模。但同样的下游覆盖范围也会扩大可搭便车的受益群体。据此，模型预测下游覆盖范围与焦点行业游说支出呈驼峰型关系。基于1999年至2023年71个美国行业的面板数据，我发现映射至LDA游说支出的数据呈现非单调模式。该模式在每年度横截面数据中均存在，且对活跃行业游说支出的影响强度大于游说进入行为。这些估计结果具有描述性特征，首先适用于可映射的游说支出。在报告的总游说支出中，仅约三分之一能清晰映射至具体行业，而部分识别边界显示，一旦考虑未映射的剩余部分，推断效力将显著减弱。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Downstream centrality and industry lobbying in production networks
title_zh: 生产网络中的下游中心性与行业游说

abstract: We study the incentive effects of vertical equalization transfers in France. Using a reform in 2017 that tightened eligibility criteria for an equalization grant, we analyze how grant losses affect municipal budget choices. Drawing on a large panel of urban municipalities covering the 2014–2024 period, we employ a staggered difference-in-differences framework to identify the causal impact of grant losses. We first show that, on average, municipalities substitute grants with local tax revenues. Second, political factors reveal heterogeneity in responses. Left-wing municipalities increase spending and simultaneously raise taxes and debt. In contrast, right-wing municipalities increase taxes but consolidate debt. Municipalities led by narrowly elected mayors pursue stronger fiscal discipline, reducing expenditures and debt. Political fragmentation within municipal councils generates patterns consistent with coalition bargaining.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了法国纵向均衡转移支付的激励效应。利用2017年一项收紧均衡拨款资格标准的改革，我们分析了拨款损失如何影响市政预算选择。基于覆盖2014—2024年期间的大型城市面板数据，我们采用交错双重差分框架来识别拨款损失的因果影响。我们首先表明，平均而言，市政当局用地方税收收入替代拨款。其次，政治因素揭示了反应的异质性。左翼市政当局增加支出，同时提高税收和债务。相比之下，右翼市政当局增加税收但巩固债务。由微弱优势当选的市长领导的市政当局追求更强的财政纪律，减少支出和债务。市政委员会内部的政治碎片化产生了与联盟谈判相一致的模式。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: When the money stops: fiscal and political reactions to changing grant eligibility
title_zh: 当资金停止：对拨款资格变化的财政与政治反应

abstract: Whether in education, performance reviews, or elections, grades serve as tools for assessment, yet the universality of their meanings remains an open question. When voting under majority judgment, voters assign verbal grades such as “excellent, very good, good, fairly good, acceptable, insufficient, to reject” to each candidate. The meaning of these grades should be clear and consistent across all voters. Balinski and Laraki (2011) describe this as a “common language” and claim that the grade labels convey absolute meaning. This paper tests the assumption of absolute meaning by examining whether the meaning of a grade depends on the grading scale (i.e., framing effect) in a political context. We conducted an online experiment (N = 1955) in which participants voted for candidates to the French presidential elections under majority judgment with grading scales with different numbers of grades. Our findings indicate that the grade distributions obtained by candidates are significantly influenced by the grading scales available to voters. Our data therefore rejects the assertion that grades convey absolute meaning, showing instead that their interpretation depends on the number of grades available.
abstract_zh: 无论是在教育、绩效评估还是选举中，评分都作为评估工具，但其含义的普遍性仍是一个未解之谜。在多数判断投票制下，选民对每位候选人给予诸如“优秀、很好、好、较好、可接受、不足、拒绝”等口头评分。这些评分的含义应当对所有选民清晰且一致。巴林斯基和拉拉基（2011）将此描述为“共同语言”，并声称评分标签传达了绝对意义。本文通过考察在政治情境下，评分的含义是否依赖于评分量表（即框架效应），来检验绝对意义的假设。我们进行了一项在线实验（N=1955），参与者使用不同评分等级数量的评分量表，在多数判断规则下对法国总统选举候选人进行投票。研究结果显示，候选人获得的评分分布显著受到选民可用的评分量表影响。因此，我们的数据否定了评分传达绝对意义的论断，表明其解释依赖于可用评分的数量。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Do grades have absolute meaning? An experiment on majority judgment
title_zh: 成绩具有绝对意义吗？多数判断实验

abstract: We estimate the fiscal externalities of a property transfer tax, the Los Angeles “Mansion Tax”, on the revenues from property taxes when assessed values are closely tied to transactions. In California, as in over half of U.S. states, growth in tax assessments between transactions lags market values, so any reduction in transaction frequency reduces the growth of property tax revenue. Assuming that Measure ULA did not directly change transaction rates outside of Los Angeles, we estimate a sizable fiscal externality: in our benchmark calibration, the resulting property-tax revenue loss offsets about four-fifths of the revenue generated by the transfer tax, and under alternative parameter values the offset can range from 30 percent to over 100 percent. The net revenue loss is larger for high-value and commercial properties.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了房产转让税（洛杉矶“豪宅税”）对房产税收入产生的财政外部性，前提是评估价值与交易紧密相关。在加利福尼亚州，如同美国超过一半的州一样，交易间隔期间的税收评估增长滞后于市场价值，因此任何交易频率的减少都会降低房产税收入的增长。假设ULA法案并未直接改变洛杉矶以外的交易率，我们估算出一个显著的财政外部性：在我们的基准校准中，由此产生的房产税收入损失抵消了转让税收入的约五分之四，而在其他参数值下，这一抵消比例可从30%到超过100%不等。对于高价值及商业房产，净收入损失更大。
title: Fiscal externalities of transaction taxes: Evidence from the Los Angeles mansion tax
title_zh: 交易税的财政外部性：来自洛杉矶豪宅税的证据

abstract: We introduce a new, powerful, and easy-to-use solution concept called simple forward induction which is implied by strategic stability in generic finite multi-sender signaling games. We apply this concept to infinite monotonic signaling games and show that a unique simple forward induction outcome exists and is non-distorted by asymmetric information. We also show that, in this class of games, the non-distorted outcome is the limit of stable outcomes of finite games. Hence, in this sense, we characterize stable outcomes in this class of games. The definition of our solution concept can be easily extended to arbitrary extensive-form games.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖、强大且易于使用的解概念，称为简单前向归纳法，该概念在一般有限多发送者信号博弈中由策略稳定性所蕴含。我们将这一概念应用于无限单调信号博弈，并证明存在唯一的简单前向归纳结果，且该结果不受信息不对称的扭曲。我们还证明，在此类博弈中，非扭曲结果是有限博弈稳定结果的极限。因此，在此意义上，我们刻画了此类博弈中的稳定结果。我们的解概念定义可轻松推广至任意扩展式博弈。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Simple forward induction in monotonic multi-sender signaling games
title_zh: 单调多发送者信号博弈中的简单前向归纳

abstract: This paper develops a political economy model in which corruption enhances political control by generating enforceable vulnerability. We conceptualize corruption as a “hostage technology”: by allowing officials to accumulate incriminating evidence, the ruler ensures that elites remain strategically fragmented and vulnerable to selective punishment. We formalize this mechanism through a coordination game of political challenge and derive a risk-dominance threshold for coalition formation. A central theoretical result is the non-monotone effectiveness of enforcement: while moderate enforcement deters political challenges, excessively strong enforcement can paradoxically undermine political control by eliminating the very leverage — incriminating evidence — needed to discipline elites. The model yields sharp comparative statics linking tolerated corruption, enforcement capacity, monitoring technology, and political threat, providing a unified theoretical explanation for the coexistence of systemic corruption and durable political stability.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个政治经济学模型，其中腐败通过生成可执行的脆弱性来增强政治控制。我们将腐败概念化为一种“人质技术”：通过允许官员积累罪证，统治者确保精英阶层保持战略上的分裂状态，并易受选择性惩罚的影响。我们通过一个政治挑战的协调博弈来形式化这一机制，并推导出联盟形成的风险主导阈值。一个核心理论结果是执法效果的非单调性：适度的执法能威慑政治挑战，而过强的执法却可能适得其反，削弱政治控制——因为它消除了用以约束精英所需的杠杆，即罪证。该模型得出了尖锐的比较静态分析，将容忍的腐败、执法能力、监控技术与政治威胁联系起来，为系统性腐败与持久政治稳定并存提供了统一的理论解释。
title: Corruption as a political control device: Enforceable vulnerability and coalition breakdown
title_zh: 作为政治控制手段的腐败：可强制执行的脆弱性与联盟瓦解

abstract: At the aggregate level, the observation that deviations from purchasing power parity (PPP) are too persistent to be accounted for solely by nominal rigidities has long been a puzzle (Rogoff 1996). In addition, microeconomic evidence suggests that deviations from the law of one price (LOP) are less persistent than PPP deviations. To reconcile these two empirical anomalies, we incorporate the behavioral inattention approach of Gabaix (2014) into a two-country sticky-price model. Our model shows that firms’ behavioral inattention to the aggregate component of real marginal costs generates an endogenous dependence of LOP deviations on PPP deviations. We find strong supporting evidence for this particular formulation of behavioral inattention. Calibrating our model with the estimated degree of attention, we show that our model can fully account for the two empirical anomalies. PPP deviations are more than twice as persistent as those implied by nominal rigidities alone, while the persistence of LOP deviations is about two-thirds that of PPP deviations.
abstract_zh: 在总体层面，购买力平价偏离的持续性远超名义刚性所能解释的范围，这一现象长期以来被视为一个谜题（Rogoff 1996）。此外，微观经济证据表明，一价定律偏离的持续性低于购买力平价偏离。为调和这两个实证异常，我们将Gabaix（2014）的行为疏忽方法引入两国粘性价格模型。模型表明，企业对实际边际成本中总体成分的行为疏忽，会内生地导致一价定律偏离对购买力平价偏离的依赖。我们找到了支持这一特定行为疏忽公式的有力证据。通过使用估计的注意力程度校准模型，我们证明该模型能够完全解释这两个实证异常：购买力平价偏离的持续性比仅由名义刚性所隐含的持续性高出两倍以上，而一价定律偏离的持续性约为购买力平价偏离的三分之二。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: A Behavioral Explanation for the Puzzling Persistence of the Aggregate Real Exchange Rate
title_zh: 实际汇率持续之谜的行为解释

abstract: We exploit Germany’s temporary three-percentage-point VAT cut in the second half of 2020 to study the spending response to unconventional fiscal policy. We use survey and scanner data on household consumption expenditures and their perceived pass-through of the tax change into prices, and a HANK model to quantify the effects of this VAT policy. The survey and scanner data show that the temporary VAT reduction led to a relative increase in durable and, to a lesser extent, semi-durable spending for individuals with high perceived pass-through. According to the HANK model, the VAT policy increased total aggregate consumption spending by 4.4 percent on impact.
abstract_zh: 本文利用德国2020年下半年临时性下调增值税三个百分点的政策，研究非传统财政政策对消费支出的影响。我们采用家庭消费支出的调查与扫描数据，以及消费者对税改价格传导的感知程度，并借助HANK模型量化该增值税政策的效果。调查与扫描数据显示，对于感知传导程度较高的群体，临时性增值税下调显著提升了耐用品支出，半耐用品支出也有较小幅度的增长。根据HANK模型测算，该增值税政策在实施初期使总消费支出增加了4.4%。
title: A Temporary VAT Cut as Unconventional Fiscal Policy
title_zh: 临时性增值税减免作为非常规财政政策
